add_atomic_razorpay_webhook_claim_finish
statements:
ALTER TABLE public.srk_razorpay_webhook_events
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS processing_claim_token uuid,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS processing_claimed_at timestamptz;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS srk_razorpay_webhook_claimable_idx
ON public.srk_razorpay_webhook_events (received_at)
WHERE processing_status IN ('received','processing_error')
  AND signature_verified_at IS NOT NULL;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.srk_service_claim_razorpay_webhook_events(
  p_limit integer DEFAULT 10
)
RETURNS TABLE(
  event_id text,
  event_type text,
  event_payload jsonb,
  razorpay_order_id text,
  razorpay_payment_id text,
  payment_amount_paise bigint,
  payment_currency text,
  razorpay_refund_id text,
  refund_amount_paise bigint,
  refund_currency text,
  processing_attempts integer,
  claim_token uuid
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF coalesce(auth.role(),'') <> 'service_role' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'SERVICE_ROLE_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  IF p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit < 1 OR p_limit > 25 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_CLAIM_LIMIT' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT e.event_id
    FROM public.srk_razorpay_webhook_events e
    WHERE e.signature_verified_at IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        (e.processing_status='received' AND e.processing_claimed_at IS NULL)
        OR
        (e.processing_status='processing_error'
          AND e.next_retry_at IS NOT NULL
          AND e.next_retry_at <= clock_timestamp()
          AND e.processing_claimed_at IS NULL)
        OR
        (e.processing_claimed_at IS NOT NULL
          AND e.processing_claimed_at < clock_timestamp() - interval '2 minutes'
          AND e.processing_status IN ('received','processing_error'))
      )
    ORDER BY e.received_at, e.event_id
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
    LIMIT p_limit
  )
  UPDATE public.srk_razorpay_webhook_events e
  SET processing_claim_token=gen_random_uuid(),
      processing_claimed_at=clock_timestamp(),
      processing_attempts=e.processing_attempts+1,
      next_retry_at=NULL,
      updated_at=clock_timestamp()
  FROM candidates c
  WHERE e.event_id=c.event_id
  RETURNING e.event_id,e.event_type,e.event_payload,e.razorpay_order_id,
    e.razorpay_payment_id,e.payment_amount_paise,e.payment_currency,
    e.razorpay_refund_id,e.refund_amount_paise,e.refund_currency,
    e.processing_attempts,e.processing_claim_token;
END;
$function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.srk_service_finish_razorpay_webhook_event(
  p_event_id text,
  p_claim_token uuid,
  p_outcome text,
  p_error text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_next_retry_at timestamptz DEFAULT NULL,
  p_reconciliation_reason text DEFAULT NULL
) RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_rows integer;
BEGIN
  IF coalesce(auth.role(),'') <> 'service_role' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'SERVICE_ROLE_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  IF p_event_id IS NULL OR p_claim_token IS NULL
     OR p_outcome NOT IN ('reconciled','exception','ignored','processing_error')
     OR (p_outcome='processing_error' AND p_next_retry_at IS NOT NULL
         AND p_next_retry_at <= clock_timestamp())
     OR (p_outcome<>'processing_error' AND p_next_retry_at IS NOT NULL) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_WEBHOOK_FINISH_INPUT' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.srk_razorpay_webhook_events
  SET processing_status=p_outcome,
      reconciliation_reason=left(coalesce(p_reconciliation_reason,p_error),1000),
      last_error=CASE WHEN p_outcome='processing_error'
        THEN left(coalesce(p_error,'Webhook processing failed'),1000) ELSE NULL END,
      next_retry_at=CASE WHEN p_outcome='processing_error'
        THEN p_next_retry_at ELSE NULL END,
      processed_at=CASE WHEN p_outcome IN ('reconciled','exception','ignored')
        THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE NULL END,
      processing_claim_token=NULL,
      processing_claimed_at=NULL,
      updated_at=clock_timestamp()
  WHERE event_id=p_event_id
    AND processing_claim_token=p_claim_token
    AND processing_claimed_at IS NOT NULL;

  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_rows = ROW_COUNT;
  IF v_rows=0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'WEBHOOK_CLAIM_NOT_FOUND_OR_EXPIRED' USING ERRCODE='55000';
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success',true,'event_id',p_event_id,'status',p_outcome);
END;
$function$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.srk_service_claim_razorpay_webhook_events(integer)
  FROM PUBLIC,anon,authenticated;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.srk_service_claim_razorpay_webhook_events(integer)
  TO service_role;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.srk_service_finish_razorpay_webhook_event(text,uuid,text,text,timestamptz,text)
  FROM PUBLIC,anon,authenticated;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.srk_service_finish_razorpay_webhook_event(text,uuid,text,text,timestamptz,text)
  TO service_role;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.srk_service_claim_razorpay_webhook_events(integer)
IS 'Atomically claims signature-verified Razorpay webhook events using SKIP LOCKED; reclaims stale claims after two minutes; service_role only.';
COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.srk_service_finish_razorpay_webhook_event(text,uuid,text,text,timestamptz,text)
IS 'Finishes a claimed Razorpay webhook using its one-time claim token; supports retry scheduling without inventing a maximum retry count; service_role only.';

statements:
-- Preserve Motor Winding history; remove it only from new active catalog use.
UPDATE public.srk_service_types
SET is_active=false,
    admin_note='User-confirmed: Motor Winding is outside SRK ELECTRONIC; no SRK booking, billing, payment, or commission.',
    updated_at=clock_timestamp()
WHERE service_code='motor_winding';

UPDATE public.srk_service_skills
SET is_active=false,
    admin_note='Deactivated because Motor Winding is outside SRK ELECTRONIC.',
    updated_at=clock_timestamp()
WHERE service_type_id=(SELECT id FROM public.srk_service_types WHERE service_code='motor_winding');

-- Motor/Pump pricing is checking, inspection and fitting only. Winding is not a separate SRK charge.
UPDATE public.srk_service_pricing_rules
SET winding_charged_separately=false,
    pricing_note='Checking, inspection and fitting only; exact approved HP-tier price; timer disabled. Motor winding is outside SRK ELECTRONIC.',
    change_reason='User reconfirmed 2026-11-23: winding is outside SRK.'
WHERE service_type_id IN (
  SELECT id FROM public.srk_service_types
  WHERE service_code IN ('motor_repair','pump_repair','motor_pump_installation')
) AND pricing_unit='motor_hp';

-- Add the user-confirmed 3 HP tier for each of the three motor/pump services.
INSERT INTO public.srk_service_pricing_hp_tiers(pricing_rule_id,motor_hp,fixed_price)
SELECT r.id,3.0,800
FROM public.srk_service_pricing_rules r
JOIN public.srk_service_types s ON s.id=r.service_type_id
WHERE s.service_code IN ('motor_repair','pump_repair','motor_pump_installation')
  AND r.pricing_unit='motor_hp'
ON CONFLICT (pricing_rule_id,motor_hp)
DO UPDATE SET fixed_price=EXCLUDED.fixed_price;

-- Apply the user-approved Fridge Repair hourly labour rates.
UPDATE public.srk_service_rates
SET technician_hourly_rate=200,
    helper_hourly_rate=120,
    rate_status='approved',
    effective_from=clock_timestamp(),
    effective_to=NULL,
    change_reason='User-approved 2026-11-23: Fridge Repair Technician ₹200/hour, Helper ₹120/hour.'
WHERE service_type_id=(SELECT id FROM public.srk_service_types WHERE service_code='fridge_repair');

INSERT INTO public.srk_service_rates(
  category_id,skill_level_id,service_type_id,
  technician_hourly_rate,helper_hourly_rate,rate_status,effective_from,change_reason
)
SELECT source.category_id,source.skill_level_id,
       (SELECT id FROM public.srk_service_types WHERE service_code='fridge_repair'),
       200,120,'approved',clock_timestamp(),
       'User-approved 2026-11-23: Fridge Repair Technician ₹200/hour, Helper ₹120/hour.'
FROM public.srk_service_rates source
WHERE source.service_type_id=(SELECT id FROM public.srk_service_types WHERE service_code='ac_repair')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.srk_service_rates existing
    WHERE existing.service_type_id=(SELECT id FROM public.srk_service_types WHERE service_code='fridge_repair')
      AND existing.skill_level_id=source.skill_level_id
      AND existing.rate_status='approved'
      AND existing.effective_to IS NULL
  );

-- Persist the user-approved remaining operating criteria.
INSERT INTO public.srk_system_settings(setting_key,setting_value,admin_note)
VALUES
('max_matching_attempts','10'::jsonb,'User-approved maximum of 10 matching attempts per booking.'),
('ai_language_test_min_pass_rate_percent','90'::jsonb,'User-approved minimum overall pass rate for Indian-language AI test suite.'),
('ai_language_test_critical_failures_allowed','0'::jsonb,'User-approved: zero critical failures in AI language tests.'),
('receipt_pdf_fields',
 '["booking_id","customer_name","customer_phone","service_name","motor_hp","work_description","work_duration","labour_charges","payment_method","payment_status","receipt_date"]'::jsonb,
 'User-approved receipt contents; no material line or company commission.'),
('backup_policy',
 '{"database":"daily","storage_objects":"daily","retention_days":30,"restore_test":"regular","offsite_required":true}'::jsonb,
 'User-approved backup target policy. Actual offsite automation requires a configured destination and credentials; this setting alone does not create backups.')
ON CONFLICT(setting_key)
DO UPDATE SET setting_value=EXCLUDED.setting_value,
              admin_note=EXCLUDED.admin_note,
              updated_at=clock_timestamp();

rows.name: approve_electrician_basic_and_residential_rates
statements:
DO $$
DECLARE
  v_count integer;
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.srk_service_rates r
  SET technician_hourly_rate = CASE
        WHEN t.service_code = 'basic_electrical' THEN 100
        WHEN t.service_code = 'residential_office_wiring' THEN 150
      END,
      helper_hourly_rate = CASE
        WHEN t.service_code = 'basic_electrical' THEN NULL
        WHEN t.service_code = 'residential_office_wiring' THEN 100
      END,
      rate_status = 'approved',
      change_reason = CASE
        WHEN t.service_code = 'basic_electrical'
          THEN 'User-approved 2026-11-23: Electrician Basic Technician ₹100/hour; no Helper.'
        WHEN t.service_code = 'residential_office_wiring'
          THEN 'User-approved 2026-11-23: Residential/Office Wiring Technician ₹150/hour and Helper ₹100/hour.'
      END
  FROM public.srk_service_types t
  JOIN public.srk_service_categories c ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN public.srk_skill_levels l ON l.category_id = c.id
  WHERE r.service_type_id = t.id
    AND r.skill_level_id = l.id
    AND c.category_code = 'electrician'
    AND ((t.service_code = 'basic_electrical' AND l.level_code = 'basic')
      OR (t.service_code = 'residential_office_wiring' AND l.level_code = 'residential_office'))
    AND r.rate_status = 'draft';
  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_count = ROW_COUNT;
  IF v_count <> 2 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expected to approve exactly 2 Electrician rates; updated %', v_count;
  END IF;
END $$;

rows.name: srk_emergency_evidence_escalation_and_settings_history
statements:
-- SRK ELECTRONIC: emergency response, evidence retention and settings history.
-- Additive-only migration; existing alert and operational records remain intact.
alter table public.srk_emergency_alerts
  add column if not exists acknowledged_by uuid,
  add column if not exists acknowledged_at timestamptz,
  add column if not exists response_due_at timestamptz,
  add column if not exists escalation_level integer not null default 0,
  add column if not exists decision_status text,
  add column if not exists decision_reason text,
  add column if not exists decided_by uuid,
  add column if not exists decided_at timestamptz,
  add column if not exists legal_hold boolean not null default false,
  add column if not exists legal_hold_reason text,
  add column if not exists retention_until timestamptz,
  add column if not exists closed_at timestamptz;

alter table public.srk_emergency_alerts
  drop constraint if exists srk_emergency_alerts_escalation_level_check;
alter table public.srk_emergency_alerts
  add constraint srk_emergency_alerts_escalation_level_check
  check (escalation_level >= 0);

alter table public.srk_emergency_alerts
  drop constraint if exists srk_emergency_alerts_decision_status_check;
alter table public.srk_emergency_alerts
  add constraint srk_emergency_alerts_decision_status_check
  check (decision_status is null or decision_status in ('genuine','false','insufficient_evidence'));

create table if not exists public.srk_emergency_evidence (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  alert_id uuid not null references public.srk_emergency_alerts(id) on delete restrict,
  uploaded_by uuid not null,
  uploader_role text not null check (uploader_role in ('customer','technician','helper','admin','staff')),
  evidence_type text not null check (evidence_type in ('photo','video','audio','document','other')),
  storage_bucket text not null,
  storage_path text not null,
  original_file_name text,
  mime_type text,
  file_size_bytes bigint check (file_size_bytes is null or file_size_bytes >= 0),
  captured_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  is_sensitive boolean not null default true,
  legal_hold boolean not null default false,
  retention_until timestamptz,
  metadata jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  unique(storage_bucket, storage_path)
);
create index if not exists srk_emergency_evidence_alert_created_idx
  on public.srk_emergency_evidence(alert_id, created_at);

create table if not exists public.srk_emergency_escalations (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  alert_id uuid not null references public.srk_emergency_alerts(id) on delete restrict,
  escalation_level integer not null check (escalation_level > 0),
  triggered_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  response_due_at timestamptz,
  notified_role text,
  notified_user_id uuid,
  delivery_channel text check (delivery_channel is null or delivery_channel in ('in_app','push','sms','call')),
  delivery_status text not null default 'queued'
    check (delivery_status in ('queued','sent','delivered','failed','acknowledged')),
  acknowledged_at timestamptz,
  failure_reason text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique(alert_id, escalation_level)
);
create index if not exists srk_emergency_escalations_due_idx
  on public.srk_emergency_escalations(response_due_at)
  where acknowledged_at is null;

create table if not exists public.srk_emergency_decision_events (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  alert_id uuid not null references public.srk_emergency_alerts(id) on delete restrict,
  decision_status text not null check (decision_status in ('genuine','false','insufficient_evidence')),
  decision_reason text not null,
  decided_by uuid not null,
  decided_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  evidence_summary text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index if not exists srk_emergency_decision_events_alert_idx
  on public.srk_emergency_decision_events(alert_id, decided_at desc);

create table if not exists public.srk_emergency_legal_holds (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  alert_id uuid not null references public.srk_emergency_alerts(id) on delete restrict,
  hold_reason text not null,
  placed_by uuid not null,
  placed_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  released_by uuid,
  released_at timestamptz,
  release_reason text,
  check ((released_at is null and released_by is null) or
         (released_at is not null and released_by is not null and release_reason is not null))
);
create index if not exists srk_emergency_legal_holds_active_idx
  on public.srk_emergency_legal_holds(alert_id) where released_at is null;

create table if not exists public.srk_system_setting_history (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  setting_key text not null,
  old_value jsonb,
  new_value jsonb not null,
  changed_by uuid not null,
  change_reason text not null,
  changed_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  applies_to_new_bookings_only boolean not null default true
);
create index if not exists srk_system_setting_history_key_time_idx
  on public.srk_system_setting_history(setting_key, changed_at desc);

-- Keep sensitive evidence and administrative history inaccessible through direct client table grants.
alter table public.srk_emergency_evidence enable row level security;
alter table public.srk_emergency_escalations enable row level security;
alter table public.srk_emergency_decision_events enable row level security;
alter table public.srk_emergency_legal_holds enable row level security;
alter table public.srk_system_setting_history enable row level security;

statements:
create table if not exists public.srk_policy_documents (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  policy_type text not null check (policy_type in ('terms','privacy')),
  audience_role text not null check (audience_role in ('customer','technician','helper')),
  language_code text not null default 'hi',
  version text not null,
  title text not null,
  body text not null,
  status text not null default 'draft' check (status in ('draft','published','retired')),
  effective_at timestamptz,
  created_by uuid,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique(policy_type,audience_role,language_code,version)
);
create unique index if not exists srk_policy_one_published_version
  on public.srk_policy_documents(policy_type,audience_role,language_code)
  where status='published';

create table if not exists public.srk_policy_consents (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid not null,
  audience_role text not null check (audience_role in ('customer','technician','helper')),
  policy_document_id uuid not null references public.srk_policy_documents(id) on delete restrict,
  accepted boolean not null,
  accepted_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  policy_version text not null,
  ip_address inet,
  user_agent text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique(user_id,audience_role,policy_document_id)
);
create index if not exists srk_policy_consents_user_time_idx
  on public.srk_policy_consents(user_id,audience_role,accepted_at desc);

create table if not exists public.srk_account_deletion_requests (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid not null,
  account_role text not null check (account_role in ('customer','technician','helper')),
  request_reason text,
  status text not null default 'requested'
    check (status in ('requested','under_review','approved','rejected','processing','completed','on_hold')),
  requested_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  reviewed_by uuid,
  reviewed_at timestamptz,
  review_reason text,
  completed_at timestamptz,
  retention_explanation text,
  legal_hold boolean not null default false,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index if not exists srk_account_deletion_user_idx
  on public.srk_account_deletion_requests(user_id,requested_at desc);

create table if not exists public.srk_backup_runs (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  backup_kind text not null check (backup_kind in ('database','storage','full')),
  started_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  completed_at timestamptz,
  status text not null default 'queued'
    check (status in ('queued','running','succeeded','failed','verified')),
  retention_until timestamptz,
  storage_reference text,
  checksum text,
  size_bytes bigint check (size_bytes is null or size_bytes>=0),
  restore_tested_at timestamptz,
  restore_test_status text check (restore_test_status is null or restore_test_status in ('passed','failed','not_run')),
  failure_reason text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index if not exists srk_backup_runs_retention_idx
  on public.srk_backup_runs(retention_until);
create index if not exists srk_backup_runs_status_idx
  on public.srk_backup_runs(status,started_at desc);

alter table public.srk_policy_documents enable row level security;
alter table public.srk_policy_consents enable row level security;
alter table public.srk_account_deletion_requests enable row level security;
alter table public.srk_backup_runs enable row level security;
